blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Provide two asynchronous register reads and one rising-edge register write for the 32 RV32 registers. Reset all registers asynchronously to zero, always return zero for x0, and ignore writes to x0.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolates architectural state for straightforward reset and x0 verification, while asynchronous reads support single-cycle execution.

blocks.name: immediate_generator
blocks.responsibility: Generate sign-extended I, S, B, and J immediates and the zero-extended U immediate from the instruction, with the required bit rearrangements and implicit zero bits.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizes immediate construction so every instruction format can be checked independently for correct bit mapping and sign extension.

blocks.name: execution_unit
blocks.responsibility: Compute RV32I register-register and immediate arithmetic, logic, comparisons, and shifts, plus all RV32M multiply, divide, and remainder results. Also evaluate all six branch conditions using signed or unsigned comparisons as appropriate.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeps arithmetic and branch semantics in one independently testable combinational block; explicit M-operation handling makes division edge cases and product widths verifiable.

blocks.name: load_store_unit
blocks.responsibility: Drive the byte-addressed effective data address, access width, store enable, and store data for LB/LH/LW/LBU/LHU and SB/SH/SW. Select the addressed byte or halfword from the aligned read word and perform the required sign or zero extension for loads.
blocks.design_rationale: Separates little-endian lane selection and bus formatting from instruction control, making memory behavior directly verifiable.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Implement the specified RV32IM single-cycle top level and expose exactly the contract bus ports. Maintain the PC, fetch the current instruction, decode instructions, select immediates and operands, instantiate the register file, immediate generator, execution unit, and load/store unit, write back results, and choose the next PC with JAL/JALR priority over taken branches and sequential execution.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeps architectural sequencing and instruction decode at the integration boundary while delegating independently verifiable datapath functions; the single-cycle structure preserves one completed instruction per rising edge.

notes: Use only ieee.std_logic_1164 and ieee.numeric_std. The top-level entity must be named cpu and have exactly the listed contract ports. Handle signed division overflow and division by zero explicitly in execution_unit; ensure all combinational outputs receive defaults.
